$Comment: A founder's badge: bring down the Headless Horseman during Hallow's Eve 2026, his first year. The
calendar_year condition passes only while that year's run is on, so after it nobody can earn
this. It has no Parent and no hallowed tag, so it is one achievement for good and The Hallowed
never waits on it. It pays nothing and gives no title: the badge is the reward.
To retire it once that season is over, set Enabled false, and in Listing add Feat true and
LegacySince naming the release it stops in. Whoever earned it keeps it among their feats with
that version beside it, and nobody else sees it sitting locked.
